# ZSM0024 — File-Local State Machine

**Severity:** Error

A `[StateMachine]` or `[StateMachineGroup]` type is declared `file`, or is nested in a `file`
type. A file-local type can only be declared in its own source file, and the generated members
are always in another file, so they can never be added to it. The generator reports ZSM0024 on
the type and generates nothing for it:

```
'MyApp.OrderMachine' is not generated because it is file-local, and a generated file cannot extend a file-local type
```

## Example

```csharp
// ZSM0024
[StateMachine(InitialState = nameof(OrderState.Pending))]
[Transition<OrderState, OrderTrigger>(From = OrderState.Pending, On = OrderTrigger.Pay, To = OrderState.Paid)]
file partial class OrderMachine { }
```

## How to fix

Remove the `file` modifier. To keep the machine out of other code, make it `internal`, or nest
it as a `private` type in a `partial` class:

```csharp
[StateMachine(InitialState = nameof(OrderState.Pending))]
[Transition<OrderState, OrderTrigger>(From = OrderState.Pending, On = OrderTrigger.Pay, To = OrderState.Paid)]
internal partial class OrderMachine { }
```

See [Where the Host Can Be Declared](../source-generator.md#where-the-host-can-be-declared).
